notes.title: Dumb Bots Update
notes.notes:
Hi all just a quick update here.

The work is still ongoing to get fully working Bots into the game for those solo players, I have been working away to try and get a dumbed down version in and working so here it is.

Currently bots will fill the match with the remaining of the 10 slots, they are VERY VERY DUMB!
Do not expect a lot from them, they will drive around stealing weapons, and chasing you from time to time but they CAN NOT SHOOT yet.

YOU CAN SHOOT THEM though, this just gives players a way of levelling up their player without being in an online match and hopefully encourage more playtime for future testing.

Please provide me with what you think of the AI so far and let me know suggestions.

Thanks
Rob.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Bots spawn in remaining places
[*] Bots try to steal weapons
[*] Bots try to ram players
[*] Bots can take damage
[*] Bots get destroyed in water just like players
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Release - Update v0.1.06
notes.notes:
So with the Steam fest coming up in the next few days I have managed to get together a demo for release on the 8th October.

This is the most stable version of the game so far, it still has a few known issues but hopefully this will allow more players to get started playing the game.

There has been a few changes since the last version, mainly custom number plates and balance changes.
Along with some Halloween theming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/10cfa393ebe04ebd5ac82a12a5469e3916382132.png[/img]

Here are the list of changes:

[u][b]v0.1.06[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added Number Plates
[*] Raised spawn points on Island to reduce clipping chance
[*] Added suicide button to menu
[*] Rocket ammo balanced (300 to 600)
[*] Flamethrower ammo balanced (700 to 400)
[*] Health kits balanced (30 to 50)
[*] Made menu spooky
[*] Added spooky
[/list]

notes.title: Model Overhaul For Release
notes.notes:
Hi all,
Thought it was time for a quick update on what's happening with Autotag.

[h3]What's New?[/h3]
Currently we got approved for release by stream so hopefully soon the game will come into early access for all to find and play for free.
Yes the game will be completely free, as a solo dev it's been had enough just getting playtesters nevermind releasing a multiplayer game with zero marketing where people can't find matches. 
I am only interested in people finding and playing my game so as long as people play I will be happy.

I have temporary removed controller support due to some menu issues I have found and to help it get through the Steam approval.

For release I am overhauling all the car models, weapons and maps to make the game a little more interesting before release, I have learned a lot in terms of modeling and using blender so It is worth making changes to the game to make it a lot nicer looking and also get rid of any assets currently used.

[h3]Playtest Status[/h3] 
The playtest is still live and ready to access if people are looking to provide me with as much feedback as possible before release so get your friends and download the playtest It would really help me out.

Thanks all for reading and here is a little preview of a new car model being added soon!
